If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm,

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.desc: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him. The situation goes too far, and everyone in the forest gets involved in the debacle. So what will the strict Bear do?

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren't they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear decides to suit a big laundry in his yard, but yet he has no idea that soon he would have to pull Masha from a puddle and a jar of jam. But it's not all- now the Bear has to sew new dresses eve-ry time when Masha will get wet or dirty.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.sub-title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha wants some sweets but first she has to transform the Bear's kitchen into a candy-making factory. As we all know, such sweet life means trouble and soon Masha gets a toothache. There is a lesson for all children who love sweets - take very good care of your teeth!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game! Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn't you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: What happens when bees overeat chocolates? Masha becomes their personal trainer! Get ready! Let's start weight loss exercises!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts him asking to feed her. The Bear cooks some porridge for her. But Masha doesn't like it. The Bear goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge her-self. But soon the porridge swells out. All the for-est inhabitants will remember this day for long…

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha and the Hare are having an epic game of hockey. When the game is at its peak, Masha goes off to find the missing puck and stumbles upon a broom. Now this is much better than a hockey stick and Masha gets an idea. But it turns out the broom can be used for things other than hockey.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.12
programme.desc: While Gwanghae meets with the envoy, Taedo rescues Jeongi from the warehouse where she has been locked away. Watching Jeongi and Taedo walk off together, Gwanghae is flooded with memories from his past. Taedo warns Jeongi that if she chooses not to be entangled with Gwanghae any longer, she must never allow her true identity as “Jeongi” to be revealed. Back at the Bunwon, Jeongi begins learning the potter's wheel under Yukdo's guidance…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.13
programme.desc: Consumed by anger, Gwanghae coldly tells Jeongi that she is no longer the person he once knew—and that she has nothing to do with him anymore. Left in tears as she gazes at the pottery she has made, Jeongi vows to earn Gwanghae's forgiveness. Meanwhile, in front of everyone at the Bunwon, Gangcheon orders that Euldam's vessels be destroyed…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.14
programme.desc: After defeating Yukdo, Jeongi meets Gangcheon's gaze with quiet confidence, leaving him visibly shaken when he learns that her family name is “Yu.” Meanwhile, the Chief Scholar presents Gwanghae with a vessel he claims was a bribe from Royal Consort Inbin. Seeking the truth, Gwanghae visits the royal artisan Mun Saseung to confirm whether the piece was made at the Bunwon—just as Jeongi steps inside.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.15
programme.desc: Unable to bring herself to shatter Euldam's vessel, Jeongi trembles before Gangcheon until Gwanghae arrives to intervene. Determined to prove himself superior to Mun Saseung, Yukdo demands a chance from Gangcheon. Jeongi agrees to assist Mun Saseung in crafting the ceremonial vessels for the Giroyeon banquet. Watching Gwanghae's special concern for Jeongi, Taedo questions why she matters to him so deeply.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.16
programme.desc: As Jeongi explains the shape of a wine cup, Gwanghae finds his gaze drawn to her lips and abruptly excuses himself, flustered by his own reaction. Later, Gangcheon is stunned to discover Euldam's pottery at the merchant guild and asks Hwa-ryeong whether Jeongi is truly Euldam's daughter. Taedo quietly observes Jeongi and Gwanghae sitting side by side before the kiln. On the day of the Giroyeon banquet, Jeongi grows increasingly anxious when the vessels fail to arrive at the hall.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.17
programme.desc: Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. A seven-speed manual transmission with a particularly short throw is available for all 911 GTS models as an alternative to the PDK.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: Fabio e Manuela si conoscono durante il pittoresco carnevale di Ivrea, famoso per la sua battaglia delle arance, e iniziano un'intensa relazione erotica.

programme.title: Mazzabubù... Quante corna stanno quaggiù?
programme.desc: Nel corso di un monologo sul tema dell'adulterio, un uomo passa in rassegna una serie di casi, più o meno celebri, di tradimenti extraconiugali. Un cast d'eccezione per una commedia a episodi sul tema delle passioni e dell'infedeltà, diretta da Mariano Laurenti con Giancarlo Giannini, Renzo Montagnani, Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Sylva Koscina, Carlo Giuffrè, Silvana Pampanini e tanti altri.

programme.title: Colpo in canna
programme.desc: L'affascinante hostess Nora Green consegna al boss Silvera una misteriosa lettera contenente una minaccia di morte. Braccata dai delinquenti, ma potendo confidare sull'aiuto di un lesto acrobata, Nora finisce per trovarsi al centro di una guerra tra bande rivali che si sta consumando sullo sfondo di Napoli. Regia del grande Fernando Di Leo, un'opera tra il noir e la commedia.

programme.title: Torino violenta
programme.desc: Droghe, omicidi, rapine. A Torino la violenza è un fatto quotidiano, ma un misterioso vigilante inizia a ripulire le strade. L'assassino è un poliziotto infiltrato per fare il lavoro che non poteva fare da poliziotto.

programme.title: Cronache di poveri amanti
programme.desc: Grande classico di Carlo Lizzani con Marcello Mastroianni e Antonella Lualdi. Nel 1925, in pieno clima fascista, si intrecciano in un quartiere popolare di Firenze le vicende del tipografo Mario e della sua fidanzata, Bianca, con quelle degli altri abitanti. Nell'animato contesto, fra drammi personali, storie d'amore e piccole vicende quotidiane, la violenza politica nera scoppia brutalmente.

programme.title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
programme.desc: Il celebre Alberto Sordi in una divertentissima commedia. Rosario Scimoni, detto Sasà, è una persona opportunista e senza scrupoli, nipote del sindaco di Catania, sempre pronto a schierarsi con chiunque possa aiutarlo. Passa dal socialismo al fascismo, cambiando fede politica con la stessa facilità con cui cambia le donne. Prova addirittura a fondare un proprio partito. Diretto da Luigi Zampa.

programme.title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
programme.desc: Espulso dalla polizia per la sua goffaggine, Pasquale Zagaria continua a indagare per dimostrare il proprio valore. Finisce così sulle tracce di un traffico di diamanti nascosti nei pompelmi, aiutato dalla combattiva moglie Pupetta.

programme.title: Il carabiniere a cavallo
programme.desc: Un giovane carabiniere vorrebbe sposarsi senza attendere gli anni di servizio previsti dal regolamento. Quando gli rubano il cavallo, la ricerca dell'animale lo trascina in una catena di equivoci e disavventure.

programme.title: I ragazzi dei Parioli
programme.desc: Un gruppo di giovani dell'alta borghesia romana trascorre le giornate tra feste, automobili e relazioni superficiali. Dietro il benessere emergono inquietudini, rivalità e il vuoto di una generazione in cerca di sé.

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: Casanova 70
programme.desc: Andrea, ufficiale della Nato, è colpito da un`ossessione che lo spinge a compiere azioni rischiose per le sue conquiste galanti. Lo psicanalista, ascoltato il racconto delle sue avventure, gli rimprovera l`eccessiva frenesia amorosa e gli consiglia una vacanza di riposo in montagna. Ma anche in vacanza Andrea non perde il vizio di correre dietro alle donne...

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Un'altra giovinezza
programme.desc: Dominic, anziano linguista ossessionato dallo studio del linguaggio, viene colpito da un fulmine e inizia a ringiovanire, acquisendo poteri paranormali. Tra fughe dai nazisti e scoperte straordinarie, il suo percorso lo porta a riscrivere il destino della sua vita e dei suoi studi.

programme.title: Spore
programme.desc: Due amiche disegnatrici di fumetti, uno stupro, un omicidio per vendetta, una fuga. Sullo sfondo gli anni Ottanta, quelli delle fanzine e del punk, del referendum contro il nucleare e di una provincia sempre troppo stretta.

programme.title: Cacciatore di teste
programme.desc: Bruno Davert è un manager del settore della carta di mezza età che ha perso il lavoro a causa di una ristrutturazione e delocalizzazione della sua azienda. Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.title: Di là dal Fiume
programme.desc: La vita crea molti ostacoli per il ragazzo di 12 anni - Tedo. Tedo appartiene alla generazione che è stata costretta allo sfollamento di massa a causa della guerra civile in Abkhazia, uno dei luoghi più belli della Georgia. La guerra civile ha portato via tutto ciò che aveva Tedo, anche la speranza. Il film racconta uno straordinario dramma interiore di un bambino, i suoi pensieri, sentimenti, passioni, dolori e sforzi per prendere le armi contro le difficoltà.

programme.title: LE PAGINE DEL NOSTRO AMORE
programme.desc: Ruby, scrittrice in cerca di ispirazione, partecipa a un ritiro per scrittori che si conclude con un contratto editoriale. Quando, però, Woody le fa scoprire la bellezza della natura, Ruby capisce di dover raccontare altre storie…

programme.title: THE INVITATION
programme.desc: Will viene invitato insieme alla sua nuova moglie Kyra a casa della propria ex. Oltre a un gruppo di vecchi amici, alla cena sono presenti anche altre persone, per lo più sconosciute tra loro. L'atmosfera amichevole, però, comincia presto a tingersi di mistero e in Will si fa strada la certezza che qualcosa di terribile stia per succedere.

programme.title: MONSTROUS
programme.desc: Una donna traumatizzata si ritrova in fuga dal suo ex marito violento con il figlio di sette anni. Nel loro nuovo e remoto santuario scoprono di avere un mostro più grande e terrificante da affrontare.

programme.title: ESCAPE ROOM
programme.desc: In cerca di una serata alternativa, un gruppo di sei amici mette alla prova la propria intelligenza con un'escape room, ma ben presto il gioco prende una svolta oscura e crudele. L'unico modo per uscire vivi da quell'incubo è riuscire a risolvere una serie di enigmi in soli sessanta minuti.

programme.title: XX Donne da morire
programme.desc: Il film è un'antologia horror tutta al femminile: 4 storie criminali di eventi soprannaturali. Al centro della narrazione, fortemente straniante, c'è Susan Jacobs, che assiste impotente al lento lasciarsi morire di fame dell'intera famiglia.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs e Octopus accettano un lavoro dal loro padrone di casa, in cambio di una lauta ricompensa: rapire un bambino. Ben presto, il bebè risveglia forti sentimenti paterni nei due truffatori, portando a complicazioni quando si tratta di riconsegnarlo.

programme.title: White Flowers
programme.desc: A Roma un uomo si sveglia in una stanza d'albergo: ha una ferita alla testa e una pistola, ma non ricorda nulla della sua identità né del suo passato. Presto si accorge di essere in pericolo, inseguito da qualcuno che vuole ucciderlo.

programme.title: Bancopaz
programme.desc: Alla Desert Savings Bank tutti sognano il colpo perfetto, ma nessuno sa che anche gli altri lo stanno pianificando. Sheila, Stuart e Jason si ritrovano nella stessa notte a svaligiare la banca, scatenando un'improbabile e caotica resa dei conti.

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: Valentin è un playboy di Acapulco. Un giorno sulla sua porta viene lasciata una bambina e l'uomo decide di crescerla come fosse sua, cambiando così stile di vita ed arrivando a conquistare Hollywood come stuntman.

programme.title: Quel momento imbarazzante
programme.desc: Tre migliori amici si fanno una promessa: quella di restare tutti single. Hanno infatti timore che le relazioni serie possano annullare le loro personalità e far cambiare il loro rapporto di amicizia. Nel momento in cui meno se lo aspettano però tre ragazze gli faranno cambiare idea.

programme.title: Jackals
programme.desc: Anni Ottanta. Justin Powell viene condotto in una baita isolata dove ad attenderlo trova la sua famiglia. I familiari hanno ingaggiato Jimmy Levine per riportarlo alla realtà e allontanarlo da una pericolosa setta a cui aveva aderito. Ma i membri della setta sono pronti a commettere una mattanza.

programme.title: Fantasmi di guerra
programme.desc: Dal regista e sceneggiatore di The Butterfly Effect, un ghost war movie che vede cinque soldati americani verso la fine della Seconda Guerra Mondiale intenti a sorvegliare un castello francese precedentemente occupato dall'alto comando nazista.

programme.title: Knight of cups
programme.desc: Il padre era solito leggere al figlio Rick (Christian Bale), ancora ragazzino, questa storia: “C'era una volta un giovane principe che il padre inviò in Egitto a cercare una perla. Ma, quando il principe arrivò, la gente gli porse una coppa.

programme.title: Codice Fantasma
programme.desc: Dopo che il suo ultimo incarico va disastrosamente male, al veterano della CIA Emerson Kent viene data un'ultima possibilità di dimostrare di saper fare ancora il suo lavoro. Il suo nuovo incarico: trasferimento e custodia di Katherine, un'operatrice della CIA.

programme.title: Anime in fiamme
programme.desc: Katie Holmes e Luke Kirby interpretano due poeti affetti da disturbo bipolare che iniziano una storia d'amore che metterà i loro cuori (e le loro menti) a dura prova.

programme.title: Un lupo mannaro americano a Parigi
programme.desc: Appena diplomati, Andy, Chris e Brad, decidono di fare un viaggio in Europa e arrivano a Parigi. Durante la loro prima sera, salgono sulla torre Eiffel e uno di loro decide di lanciarsi, legandosi ad una corda elastica. All'improvviso appare ai suoi occhi una ragazza che sta per suicidarsi... La ragazza, in realtà, è una licantropa che oltre ad innamorarsi, lo infetta con un morso...

programme.title: Il primo raccolto
programme.desc: Quando Sarah scopre che il vigneto della sua famiglia è in vendita, lascia la sua frenetica vita urbana e visita la sua città natale per aiutare con la vendita e avere il suo ultimo raccolto. Con l'aiuto del bel vicino Gabe, Sarah deve decidere se tornare alla sua vita frenetica o seguire il suo cuore.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack, uno sceneggiatore in crisi, incontra per caso Maria, una donna affascinante e superstiziosa che crede fermamente nelle previsioni della sua veggente. Tra rituali, superstizioni e una famiglia invadente, la loro relazione sembra destinata al caos. Eppure, Jack scopre che l'amore può sfidare anche il destino. Ma riusciranno a superare le differenze culturali delle loro famiglie?

programme.title: La meta del cuore
programme.desc: Il suo sogno è sempre stato quello di organizzare eventi, ecco perché quando i suoi migliori amici decidono di sposarsi, Madison si offre di occuparsi lei di tutto. Sceglie come location una piccola isola sperduta della Nuova Zelanda dove l'affascinante David possiede un vigneto molto suggestivo e si offre di aiutarla nei preparativi.

programme.title: Rapita
programme.desc: Nuova nei sobborghi, Jessica fa amicizia con il suo strano vicino, ma presto si ritrova bloccata nel suo rifugio sotterraneo in stile anni '50.

programme.title: Amore al primo scatto
programme.desc: Laura, assistente di galleria e aspirante fotografa d'arte, finalmente riceve la promessa di un posto in una vetrina per nuovi artisti - ma solo se riesce a convincere un artista introverso, Shane, a presentare le sue ultime fotografie in galleria. Quando Laura scopre che Shane non ha scattato una nuova foto in dieci anni, è determinata ad aiutarlo a tornare alla sua arte, che lui lo voglia o meno.

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: Kelly è una giovane, creativa e ambiziosa pianificatrice di eventi a New York e sta rapidamente guadagnando reputazione come una delle migliori nel settore. Ma quando Joe, un editore di siti web testardo, difficile ma influente, la assume per organizzare il compleanno della nipote di 10 anni, Kelly si rende rapidamente conto di aver appena incontrato il suo match.

programme.title: La Combinazione Perfetta
programme.desc: La professionista pianificatrice Gwen si impegna ad aiutare a mettere i tocchi finali al matrimonio della sua migliore amica. Ma quando viene abbinata al testimone Josh, una guida naturalistica, scopre che questo matrimonio potrebbe non essere così facile come pensava.

programme.title: Destinazione Matrimonio
programme.desc: Due perfetti sconosciuti si incontrano a un matrimonio in un'isola tropicale: lei è la testimone della sposa, lui il miglior amico dello sposo. Tra brindisi, gaffe e balli sotto le stelle, la loro iniziale antipatia si trasforma lentamente in qualcosa di più…

programme.title: Woman wanted
programme.desc: Emma viene assunta come governante da Richard, un vedovo solitario, e suo figlio Wendell, un ragazzo tormentato dal lutto. La sua presenza porta luce nella casa, ma accende anche una rivalità inaspettata: quando sia il padre che il figlio si innamorano di lei, le tensioni esplodono.

programme.title: Una bugia per amore
programme.desc: Innamorato di una donna ebrea, un uomo decide di fingersi un membro della comunità ebraica allo scopo di conquistarla.

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Basato sulla saga di best seller mondiali scritta dall'americana Lauren Kate, FALLEN ha per protagonista Lucinda “Luce” Price, una diciassettenne dalla forte forza di volontà che apparentemente sembra vivere una vita normale, fino a quando non viene accusata di un crimine che non ha commesso.

programme.title: Fukushima
programme.desc: Giappone, 11 marzo 2011. L'intero paese è scosso da un terribile terremoto che causa danni immensi. Lo smottamento della terra, infatti, scatena un violentissimo tsunami che si abbatte sulle coste del paese lasciandosi dietro migliaia di morti.

programme.title: Unless
programme.desc: Una scrittrice scopre che la sua figlia più grande, dopo aver lasciato il college, ha deciso di vivere per strada con un cartello che recita ‘Bontà'. Nel tentativo di risolvere la crisi della figlia, Reta dovrà anche combattere le difficoltà del suo lavoro.

programme.title: L'amore oltre la guerra
programme.desc: Un soldato tedesco cerca di capire se la resistenza olandese è riuscita a far infiltrare una spia nella casa del Kaiser Wilhem in Olanda all'inizio della Seconda guerra mondiale. Durante l'indagine finirà però con l'innamorarsi di una olandese ebrea.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling è Dan, un insegnante di una scuola pubblica brillante e capace di motivare i suoi allievi. Ma giunta la sera vive un profondo tormento interiore che lo porta a consumare la sua esistenza nell'abuso di alcool e droghe. Sarà la nascita dell'amicizia con un'allieva a cambiare tutto.

programme.title: Un matrimonio su misura
programme.desc: Cassie, contabile e perfezionista, crede che la sua vita sia perfettamente sulla buona strada, almeno fino a quella di sua madre la wedding planner abbandona e torna nella sua città natale per organizzare l'evento.

programme.title: Unestate a Firenze
programme.desc: L'incontro tra un giocatore di football americano e una ragazza in visita alla cugina. Un amore che nasce sullo sfondo di Firenze.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Alex, un pittore, viene lasciato dalla sua ragazza dopo che la sua mostra fallisce. Nel fratttempo, si trasferisce in un condominio decrepito dove, circondato da eccentrici vicini, l'artista scopre di essere attratto dalla nuova residente Lori.

programme.title: Un dolce incontro
programme.desc: Quando Mikayla incontra il proprietario di un bar e aspirante pasticcere Austin, i due stringono un accordo: lei assaggerà i suoi dolci se lui le darà consigli d'amore. Scoppierà la scintilla tra loro?

programme.title: Latelier dei miei sogni
programme.desc: La stilista Skye si sposta con un "camion della moda"ma non può guidare il camion e gestire l'attività da sola. L'aiuto arriva sotto forma de Kevin. Mentre lavorano insieme, Skye e Kevin scoprono di avere più cose in comune di quanto pensassero...

programme.title: Perché ho rapito il mio capo Perché ho rapito il mio capo
programme.desc: Il cattivo capo di Anna soffre di amnesia e si trasforma nell'uomo più gentile del mondo.

programme.title: Un'estate da ricordare Un'estate da ricordare
programme.desc: Zoe e Luke volevano condividere il loro primo bacio ma furono interrotti. Quindici anni dopo si ritrovano.

programme.title: Amore in azione Amore in azione
programme.desc: Un esperto di fitness deve mettere in forma una star del cinema per il suo prossimo film d'azione.

programme.title: Un anello a primavera Un anello a primavera
programme.desc: Caryn è una consulente aziendale e crede di essere destinata a rimanere single.

programme.title: Trekking con sorpresa Trekking con sorpresa
programme.desc: Un nonno riunisce la famiglia a Maiorca per annunciare il suo matrimonio e ristabilire armonia.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: L'ultimo amore di Casanova
programme.desc: Figlio del XVIII secolo, avventuriero veneziano e amante del piacere, del gioco d'azzardo e dell'avventura: sono questi i tratti che caratterizzano Giacomo Casanova, che - in cerca di nuove emozioni - decide di recarsi a Londra, una città in cui non ha mai messo piede prima. L'unico posto che conosce è quello che gli è stato consigliato dal Cardinale de Bernis, un famoso ed elegante bordello gestito da un francese.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Sing Street
programme.desc: Un ragazzo cresciuto a Dublino durante gli anni '80 evade dalla sua complicata situazione familiare, formando una band per far colpo sulla ragazza che gli piace.

programme.title: Tutto Ciò che Voglio
programme.desc: Wendy è Autistica, viene aiutata dalla terapia della struttura specializzata di Scottie, proteggendo la sua rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva Star Trek.

programme.title: The Farewell, Una Bugia Buona
programme.desc: Billi, nata in Cina e cresciuta negli USA, tornata a malincuore a Changchun, scopre che in famiglia tutti sanno che alla sua amata nonna restano solo poche settimane di vita, ma hanno deciso di tenere nascosta la verità alla diretta interessata.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: As Good as It Gets
programme.desc: Melvin odia le donne, i gay ed è pieno di manie. Ma qualcosa è destinato a cambiare. C'era una volta, un misogino, ossessionato da una serie infinita di complessi e manie e dotato di una lingua avvelenata. Ma dopo l'incontro con un cane e con una bella cameriera, qualcosa cambia e l'orco si rivela un burbero benefico.

programme.title: Scappo dalla città 2
programme.desc: In questo sequel, Mitch Robbins (Billy Crystal) e il fratello Glen (Jon Lovitz), la pecora nera della famiglia, trovano per caso una vecchia mappa del tesoro nella fascia del cappello del defunto Curly. Dopo aver scoperto che il padre di Curly aveva partecipato a un famoso furto ad un treno, si chiedono se la mappa nasconda davvero la chiave ad un tesoro.

programme.title: Una ragazza sfrenata
programme.desc: Un'ereditiera insoddisfatta è il bersaglio di un insospettabile ladro d'auto che viene trascinata inavvertitamente in un complotto per sequestrarla

programme.title: Tutte Pazze Per Charlie
programme.desc: A una festa, Chuck, dieci anni, non rispetta la regola del gioco della bottiglia, rifiutandosi di baciare una ragazza. Determinata a non far trovare a Chuck il vero amore, questa, per vendetta, gli getta il malocchio. Vent'anni dopo Chuck è un dentista che non riesce ad avere una relazione stabile.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall e Joy Bryant sono i protagonisti di questa divertentissima commedia romantica su ciò che gli uomini e le donne cercano in un rapporto a due. Bernie (Kevin Hart) e Joan (Regina Hall) sono una coppia a cui piace molto flirtare, passionali in tutto dalle conquiste alle rotture. Quando lui combina un incontro tra il suo migliore amico Danny (Michael Ealy), e la coinquilina di Joan, Debbie (Joy Bryant), tra i due scatta subito una forte attrazione e iniziano a frequentarsi, ma il rapporto non è semplice e Danny e Debbie cercano di sopravvivere barcamenandosi tra i problemi della vita reale e la camera da letto.

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: Riuscirà l'avvocato Franco Benenato a sconfiggere il suo acerrimo nemico il pretore Ciccio De Ingras?
programme.desc: Il pretore Ciccio, stanco dell'avv. Benenato, dopo il trasferimento di questi, si sente meglio finché a Milano non trova una sorpresa

programme.title: Oh dolci baci e languide carezze
programme.desc: Un ingegnere si invaghisce di una hippy, finisce denunciato per droga e accusato di sedurre due minorenni

programme.title: Tutti a squola
programme.desc: Un professore all'antica finisce in galera per droga e guadagna popolarità tra gli studenti

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: La donna più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Gina Lollobrigida interpreta una donna affascinante e ambiziosa che cerca di farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo. Tra amori e tradimenti, la sua bellezza diventa sia un vantaggio che una trappola, esplorando la superficialità e le difficoltà della fama.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Quando un impiegato di un parco dei divertimenti a tema medievale (Lawrence) viene magicamente trasportato indietro nell'Inghilterra del XIV secolo, deve combattere contro un re malvagio, sicari letali... e delle tubature davvero orribili!

programme.title: Uno sposato sotto tiro
programme.desc: Il mondo di Michael viene sconvolto quando la compagna lo abbandona nel deserto, dove un adolescente gli ruba l'auto e viene preso in ostaggio durante una rapina al Sip and Zip locale.

programme.title: Crimen Perfecto
programme.desc: Rafael è un uomo distinto, fascinoso e donnaiolo. Di sposarsi non ne vuol sapere e si gode il successo come venditore di un grande magazzino dove è il re incontrastato del reparto femminile. Quando uccide involontariamente un suo collega dovrà vedersela con i ricattati di una misteriosa commessa.

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: La promettente carriera di uno scrittore comico è completamente deragliata dalle sue folli dipendenze da droghe che lo hanno inseguito da burattini e sparato mentre fa da babysitter alla figlia.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: La casa dei sogni
programme.desc: Una coppia cerca la casa perfetta in cui andare a vivere e decide di assumere un architetto. L'uomo, invece di svolgere il lavoro per il quale era stato assunto, progetta la dimora dei propri sogni.

programme.title: Io, Dio E Bin Laden
programme.desc: Gary Faulkner, ex detenuto disoccupato, parte per il Pakistan armato solo di una spada acquistata in TV. Convinto che Dio gliel'abbia chiesto, tenta di catturare Osama Bin Laden compiendo undici viaggi in una folle missione solitaria.

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: Golia e il cavaliere mascherato
programme.desc: Tra castelli, duelli e congiure, Golia affronta nemici mascherati per difendere il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Golia alla conquista di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: I Pirati della Malesia
programme.desc: Tra esotiche terre d'Oriente, il leggendario Sandokan guida i suoi uomini contro il dominio coloniale, tra battaglie navali e avventure senza sosta. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi, con Steve Reeves.

programme.title: Dove si spara di più
programme.desc: Due famiglie rivali vivono in un ciclo di odio e violenza. Quando la figlia dei Campos e il figlio dei Mounter si innamorano, il loro legame proibito accende ancora più rancore, spingendo i clan verso nuove tragedie mentre cercano di difendere ciò che resta del loro onore.

programme.desc: Un uomo rintraccia i cinque fuorilegge che hanno ucciso suo fratello, mentre viene pedinato da un misterioso detective Pinkerton.

programme.desc: Un'importante rapina va male, mentre due giovani uomini si ritrovano a ostacolare banditi messicani e malvagi uomini d'affari corrotti che vogliono indietro il loro bottino rubato.

programme.title: 3 colpi di Winchester per Ringo
programme.desc: Ringo Carson salva Jane dai rapitori, litiga con il suo amico Frank e si riconcilia con la madre per difendere la sua terra da Daniels. Ma quando Frank torna dalla guerra, i conflitti riesplodono. "3 colpi di Winchester per Ringo" è un western di amicizie tradite, amore e vendetta nel selvaggio West.

programme.desc: Un abile pistolero sfida i leader di Daugherty per rubare $100.000 destinati alla ferrovia.

programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.
